name: Coel

attributes.attribute: ancient Celtic god demoted into a human king
nursery rhyme figure drawn from the god Coel
town that keeps the name of Coel

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The nursery rhyme calls Old King Cole a merry old soul. Coel was no king. Coel Hen, meaning old Coel, was an ancient Celtic god whose status writers later shrank into a plain human. His name lives on in the town of Colchester.

okr.objective: Coel is an ancient Celtic god who became the human Old King Cole of a rhyme.
key_results: Writers shrank the god into a human king.
His name still lives in the town of Colchester.
